claims.text: The hotel is located directly in the pedestrianized Piazza Santa Maria Novella in Florence's historic center.

findings.quote: located directly in Piazza Santa Maria Novella.
Situated in a pedestrianized piazza within the UNESCO World Heritage site

claims.text: The hotel is 350 metres from Santa Maria Novella station and a 6-minute walk from the Duomo.

findings.quote: the property is located **350 metres from Santa Maria Novella station** and a **6-minute walk from the Duomo**

claims.text: The building began as housing for the monks of Santa Maria Novella over seven hundred years ago.

findings.quote: The building began as housing for the monks of Santa Maria Novella over seven-hundred-years ago

claims.text: The palazzo was converted into an inn for travelers in 1848.

findings.quote: opening as an inn for travelers in 1848

claims.text: Unique Rooms such as Suite 103 feature preserved 18th-century frescoes and high ceilings.

findings.quote: Unique Rooms such as Suite 103 feature preserved 18th-century frescoes and high ceilings

claims.text: Sculptures by Emilio Greco are in the main lobby and common areas.

findings.quote: | **Emilio Greco** | Sculptor and illustrator; 20th-century sculpture | Main lobby and common areas |

claims.text: Futurist and metaphysical sketches by Carlo Carra are in select suites.

findings.quote: | **Carlo Carrà** | Futurist and metaphysical sketches | Select luxury suites |

claims.text: Carlo Scarpa's ground-floor breakfast room, with his original chairs, has been left virtually untouched.

findings.quote: Scarpa’s ground floor space—pale sea green with a jazzy monochrome floor and his original chairs—has been left virtually untouched

claims.text: Guest room windows are soundproofed.

findings.quote: framing the Florence Duomo, Giotto’s Bell Tower, and the cloisters of Santa Maria Novella through soundproofed windows

claims.text: The marble bathrooms are supplied with products by local perfumer Lorenzo Villoresi.

findings.quote: The contemporary marble bathrooms are supplied with local perfume guru Lorenzo Villoresi’s classy products.

claims.text: For families, the hotel provides children's kits, welcome gifts and a Kids' Concierge.

findings.quote: dedicated children's kits, welcome gifts, and a specialized Kids' Concierge

claims.text: La Buona Novella, the hotel's street-level restaurant with a summer terrace on the piazza, serves elevated versions of regional classics.

findings.quote: On street level, with a summer terrace on the piazza, is La Buona Novella, the hotel’s gourmet options where chef Edoardo Papiani whips up elevated versions of regional classics

claims.text: A bar with a heated swimming pool sits on the very top of the palazzo, with a 360-degree view of the city and its monuments.

findings.quote: A bar with a swimming pool on the very top of a Thirteenth Century Palazzo, with a 360-degree view of the city and monuments.
alongside a heated rooftop pool

claims.text: A window frame Carlo Scarpa designed for the hotel is identical to the frames he created for the Uffizi Gallery.

findings.quote: A defining architectural element is the customized window frame designed by Carlo Scarpa in 1958, identical to the frames he created for the Uffizi Gallery.

claims.text: When Carlo Scarpa transformed the hotel, he left a few rooms unaltered, with frescoes and original hand-painted ancient wooden beams that still exist today.

findings.quote: The _Maestro_, as he was known, deconstructed and transformed the hotel, leaving unaltered only a few rooms, with beautiful frescoes and original hand-painted ancient wooden beams that still exist today.

claims.text: Work by Fluxus artist Giuseppe Chiari covers all the walls of the breakfast room.

findings.quote: exponent of the Fluxus movement, covering all the walls of our breakfast room

claims.text: Most of the hotel's windows frame a view of Florence, the Duomo or the Cloisters of Santa Maria Novella.

findings.quote: Most of our windows frame a stunning view of Florence, the Duomo or the Cloisters of Santa Maria Novella.

claims.text: The heated rooftop pool is seasonal, not open year-round.

findings.quote: Seasonal heated terrace pool
Open seasonally from April to October.

claims.text: The hotel sits in a car-free pedestrian zone; valet parking is available.

findings.quote: with valet parking available in the car-free pedestrian zone

claims.text: In the evening the rooftop pool bar also welcomes non-hotel guests.

findings.quote: The pool bar welcomes non-hotel guests,
from 7:30 pm till midnight
